reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the Al2O3 reinforcement approach, volume fraction, processing route, strengthening mechanism, and quantitative strength improvement from the CrFeCuMnNi HEA composite studies (P1, P2, P5) to a different alloy system, (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38, without providing a justification for why the caloric response would be preserved in this magnetocaloric material, which is not addressed in the cited passages. The core idea is essentially a replication of a known result on a new alloy, with only a generic claim of inertness regarding caloric effects.
